prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Redesign Story Screen with Split Layout: Redesign the opening story screen using a split layout with companion imagery and clear intro text.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Meet your interactive pet that lives right on your desktop, ready to hang out while you work."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign In After Pet Selection: Move the sign_in step after pet creation screens so users pick their pet before registering.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, new_screen] Add Desktop Placement Checklist Screen: Insert a new screen before home_intro that guides users through desktop permissions and visibility setup.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_prep", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_prep": {"headline": "Desktop Setup Guide", "body": "Ensure your pet renders smoothly on your desktop.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Check desktop window permissions"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Add Custom Pet Guidelines Sub Flow: Insert a photo guidelines screen before photo upload to explain optimal pet photo lighting and pose.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_photo_tips", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_tips": {"headline": "Photo Upload Tips", "body": "Follow these quick tips for the best custom pet rendering results.", "layout": "card"}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Add Account Persistence Warning on Sign In: Display a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that pet data connects directly to the authenticated account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your primary account to keep your pet saved and synced."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Add Generation Status Progress Bar: Show dynamic time estimates and progress info on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "Generating companion graphics... This takes about 2 minutes."}}
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Background Notification: Enable background completion notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "body": "You can minimize this window. We'll alert you when your pet is ready!"}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Show Starter Pet Accessory Bonus: Display a bonus badge on choose_path offering a free starter accessory upon completing setup.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Path & Claim Free Starter Outfit", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Bonus Outfit Included", "style": "playful"}]}}
8: [adoption, layout] Two Column Adoption Certificate Layout: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to two_column for a cleaner certificate presentation.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate"}}
9: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Control Quick Reference: Update home_intro text to clearly detail how to right-click, hide, or talk to the pet once on desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to adjust controls, hide it, or start chatting."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the story screen with a split layout is permitted inside onboarding.
Reordering sign-in to occur after pet selection is explicitly allowed.
Adding a new setup checklist screen before home_intro is allowed.
Adding a new photo guidelines sub-flow screen is allowed.
Adding account persistence hints to sign-in is allowed.
Adding real time estimates and progress info to the waiting screen is permitted.
Enabling background completion notifications on the waiting screen is permitted.
Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or bonus gifts.
Redesigning the adoption certificate layout is permitted.
Updating home intro quick reference copy is allowed.
